preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i < i for i in range(2, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each road connection p_i must be a valid city index less than the current city index i.
The number of bus routes m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in bus_routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route must connect two distinct valid cities.
The number of questions q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n and v != u for v, u in questions)
preconditions.description: Each question must involve two distinct valid cities.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else str(min_buses)
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to reach city u from city v, output -1; otherwise, output the minimum number of buses needed.
